description: Golden set of annotated JD excerpts for the Phase 3 job-risk lens (red flags). Each case pairs a JD excerpt with the human-labeled red flag(s) a correct analysis should surface. Today these keep the annotation vocabulary consistent with the JdRedFlag schema; the model-quality comparison runs once a real (non-Fake) provider is wired into the eval harness.

录用后派驻甲方现场办公，劳动关系与外包公司签订。
